desc: Master pump switch (Circuit C) — 2-pole (DPST) IP67 sealed rocker/disconnect 12V ≥10A/pole
hint: source at Amazon: pin the listing (SKU/ASIN + URL) + confirm a firm price (single value, not a range) in new_low/new_high
cur_spec: One manual cutoff for the whole pump circuit, mounted on the EP; the supply pumps run on their internal pressure switches, the drain pumps also on local switches S-05/S-03 (drain-pump-switches). 2-POLE so the single throw kills BOTH pump fuses — pole 1 gates C1 (corridor pumps P-01/02/03/05, 15A), pole 2 gates C2 (tray-drain P-04, 10A) — each pole carries only one pump (≤7.5A), so no uprating vs the retired single-pole switch. The split lets a supply pump (C1) and the tray drain (P-04/C2) run concurrently (continuous flow-through wash) without a single fuse at 100%.
